notes: DCA 6-2015 Table B3 (p. B5), Footing Sizes Based on Tributary Area for Various Soil Capacities, under the Connecticut 2022 pack. Each hand-authored expectation was read from the page (PDF sha256 205d57b5...3009e), not exported from the pack: the per-row cases were written from the PDF's text layer (pdftotext -layout, pp. B3-B5), while the pack's rows were typed from the page rendered at 500 dpi, so this file cross-checks the two readings. Per row one case, cycling: a corner post at the row's band or 9 sq ft inside it; a centre post under a continuous beam at 4/5 of the band, so note 2's x 1.25 lands exactly on it, or 3 sq ft less; or a centre post on a spliced beam, not multiplied, 5 sq ft inside; the soil bearing value at the column's, 250 psf over it, or 499 psf over it (1500 psf over the 3000 psf column), so a value between two columns reads the lower. Then the worked example, a case per guide scope limit, the inputs the scope and table ask for, and the column refusals. The generated cases are GoldenRunner.DeckBoundaries' output, committed.
